ceo_directive: Extract maximum defensible invention intelligence per PatSnap credit

rules.title: Never spend claims budget before constructing candidate funnel
rules.order: COMPANY_CORPUS → FAMILY_COLLAPSE → TECH_SEARCH → RANK → SELECT → CLAIM_RETRIEVAL → PASSAGE → 102 → 103

rules.title: Use P005 intelligently
rules.detail: One well-designed 147-result corpus retrieval > dozens of small calls. Save raw discovery. Never rediscover same company.

rules.title: Separate discovery from evidence
rules.detail: P005/P075 = DISCOVERY_EVIDENCE (not CLAIM_EVIDENCE). Patent enters 102/103 only after P018.

rules.title: Batch P018
rules.detail: Comma-separated patent_numbers for batch retrieval. Cache permanently. Never retrieve same claims twice.

rules.title: Use query-count before expensive retrieval
rules.detail: COUNT → if 0 discard, if enormous refine, if manageable retrieve

rules.title: Search physics not vocabulary
rules.detail: Three search families: vocabulary, functional mechanism, failure/engineering mechanism

rules.title: Spend claims on strongest threats first
rules.detail: Rank by limitation_overlap, mechanism_similarity, anatomy, assignee, claim_scope, citations

rules.title: Search target company's own portfolio separately
rules.detail: SELF-IP → FAMILY → CLAIM_AUDIT. Self-IP can kill invention before external work.

rules.title: Build evidence budget before execution
rules.detail: Reserve credits for final hostile attack. Never spend reserve during exploration.

rules.title: Check balance before every expensive phase
rules.detail: BEFORE_CALL → AFTER_CALL → CREDITS_STATE → RESULTS_STATE. If exhausted: STOP, CACHE, LEDGER, BLOCKED.

rules.title: Never let API availability determine invention quality
rules.detail: API unavailable → switch to fallback ladder. Never convert to 'no prior art found'.

rules.title: PatSnap efficiency metric
rules.detail: Track: patents_discovered, families_identified, claims_retrieved, unique_claims, passages_charted, api_calls, successful_calls, failed_calls, credits_wasted, duplicate_calls, evidence_yield

rules.title: Protect the final hostile attack
rules.detail: Reserve resources for: closest semantic, self-IP, combination prior art, mechanism-level, design-around, strongest 103

rules.title: Evidence Yield = useful claim-level evidence / PatSnap consumption
